reviews.title: Abusive and pornographic ads
reviews.text:
App tricked me into clicking a link that opened a site in my browser with explicit and pornographic content, then pretended to show me that I’d used “Apple Pay” to send “PornHub” hundreds of dollars, then accused me of accessing child pornography and tried to force me to call a phone number.

Savvy users won’t be fooled by this, but it is disgusting and inappropriate and, needless to say, really killed the rhythm of my practicing.  What if a child were using this for practicing?

reviews.title: Graphic ads
reviews.text: I liked this app a lot but I will no longer use it, based on principle. After a recent update, it now includes “ads” that are designed to look graphic (like adult content) at a small scale, but technically aren’t X-rated. You can “pay to go ad-free” as a means of disabling this. I find this tactic to be extortionary and have migrated to another metronome app.

reviews.title: Great metronome, but beware of ads- NOT AGE APPROPRIATE!
reviews.text: This is a fantastic metronome.  Tap feature is great, sounds are good.  I have used it for years.  However, they have recently started running ads at the bottom of the screen that are absolutely vile.  I can’t have my students exposed to porn during lessons, so I will be switching to another metronome app.  The age rating should not be 4+.  If you are going to run ads like that, please switch the age rating to MA.
